name: Prophet

text.trigger: An exiled player controls a survivor who stands at the same location as a non-exiled survivor.
text.vignette: You are alone on a quiet corner with a message to deliver when a stray from the colony wanders into view, unaware of how close you are. You have a speech ready, and a brick to hand if the speech does not take.

options.win-them-over: Speak to them gently: recruit a non-exiled survivor who stands where one of yours does (never the last survivor of its player).
options.leave-a-warning: Make your point harder and leave it where the colony will see: the colony loses 1 morale.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #29; Needs an exiled player, so it is left out of the co-op variant. A survivor cannot be taken from a player's last survivor.
